work.englishTitle: Secret B No. 4: Magarin (Muscle Queen) Photobook
work.summary: Standalone physical photobook featuring Magarin (마가린), a Korean model and creator. MAXQ identifies this as the fourth single-volume Secret B photobook, and the available creator-profile coverage identifies Magarin as an influencer. No digital edition was established in this capture.

edition.contentSummary: Physical single-volume Secret B No. 4 photobook featuring Magarin as the sole model. Youngpoong's book record gives publisher 맥스큐인터내셔널, release date 2024-12-27, and 114 pages. Its displayed 9772799363000 code is a serial barcode, not an ISBN, and is not placed in the ISBN field. Spomax's official product page displays KRW 25,000 but also shows a SOLD OUT marker alongside purchase controls; status is stored as unknown and availability is not asserted. The cover is omitted because no exact-image reuse permission was established.
